changeSet.author: miniandmore
changeSet.comment: Backfill physical delivery anchor for return eligibility when provider status is delivered.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE customer_order SET shipment_delivered_at = ledgerly_tracking_last_pulled_at WHERE shipment_delivered_at IS NULL AND ledgerly_tracking_last_pulled_at IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(ledgerly_order_status)) IN ('delivered', 'completed');
UPDATE customer_order SET shipment_delivered_at = zoho_tracking_last_pulled_at WHERE shipment_delivered_at IS NULL AND zoho_tracking_last_pulled_at IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(zoho_order_status)) IN ('delivered', 'completed');
